name: Upadacitinib
route_note: oral extended-release tablets once daily; oral solution for children

discovery.note: Designed for greater selectivity for JAK1 over JAK2, JAK3 and TYK2.

tagline: JAK1-selective inhibitor approved across arthritis, eczema and inflammatory bowel disease
summary: Upadacitinib is an oral, once-daily inhibitor with selectivity for JAK1. Since 2019 it has been approved for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, axial spondyloarthritis, atopic dermatitis, ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease and giant cell arteritis. It shares the class boxed warnings of JAK inhibitors.
mechanism: Upadacitinib inhibits JAK1 more potently than other JAK family members, blocking signalling of cytokines that pair JAK1 with other JAKs, including interleukin-6, interferon-gamma and the gamma-chain cytokines.

Reduced STAT activation lowers inflammation in synovium, skin and gut. The relative sparing of JAK2 was intended to limit effects on erythropoiesis and platelet production, although clinical selectivity is partial at therapeutic doses.
uses: Ankylosing spondylitis and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis

history.title: FDA and EU approval
history.detail: Rinvoq approved for rheumatoid arthritis after the SELECT programme.

history.title: Psoriatic arthritis
history.detail: FDA approves use in psoriatic arthritis; EU approves atopic dermatitis.

history.title: Wider indications
history.detail: FDA approves atopic dermatitis, ulcerative colitis, ankylosing spondylitis and non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis.

history.title: Crohn's disease
history.detail: FDA approves upadacitinib for Crohn's disease, the first oral advanced therapy for it.

history.title: Giant cell arteritis
history.detail: FDA approves use in giant cell arteritis.

safety.boxed_warning: Serious infections, higher all-cause mortality, malignancies including lymphoma and lung cancer, major adverse cardiovascular events and thrombosis, based largely on the ORAL Surveillance trial of tofacitinib in older RA patients with cardiovascular risk factors (class warning for JAK inhibitors).
